days.label: Benchmark Day 1
days.session_notes: Use the workouts this week to practice your movement and test your strength. A week to test

sections.name: Training Prep
sections.time_note: Focus on finding today’s range of motion and activating the supporting muscle groups for the big LFT

exercises.label: 1a
exercises.name: 1/2 kneeling hip flexor
exercises.notes: Gently rock into and out of stretch to open the front of the hips.

exercises.label: 1b
exercises.name: Contralateral Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Engage the core and slowly lower opposite arm & leg to the ground, keeping core engaged during return to starting position , repeat with other limbs.

exercises.label: 1c
exercises.name: Pelvic Tilts
exercises.notes: other limbs. Keep the core engaged while tucking the tailbone underneath. This bracing will apply to the Main LFT in the workout.

exercises.label: 1d
exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat w/ Pause
exercises.notes: the Main LFT in the workout. Slow continuous reps, pausing at the deepest position.

exercises.label: 1e
exercises.name: Drop Squat to Pause
exercises.notes: Land and hold position, Reset after each rep. Speeding the pattern up to prep for a big lift.

exercises.name: Back/Front Squat
exercises.notes: Build to a heavy 3 to 5 rep max. Let your ability to maintain good positioning be the indicator for loading. Choose between back or front squat

exercises.name: Pull Up/Chin Up
exercises.notes: Use as little assistance as need to build up to a max effort set. Be sure to drive the elbows into the ribs to get a big pull every time!

exercises.name: DB Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: Hold DBs by sides. Step Back into lunge. Pick a weight that challenges the legs. Rest while partner works.

exercises.name: DB Chest Supported Row
exercises.notes: Bench set to 30 degrees. Big pulls on each rep, getting the DBs towards the hips rather than armpits.

exercises.name: KB/DB Curtis P Complex Front Rack Squat -> Lunge R-> L Left -> Push
exercises.notes: Complete the complex and repeat for the time allotted. Pick a pace that allows you to move steadily without gassing out. 1 rep of each exercise.

sections.name: Training Prep
sections.time_note: Focus on finding today’s range of motion and activating the supporting muscle groups for the big LFT

exercises.label: 1a
exercises.name: Hinged Over Single Arm Lat Stretch
exercises.notes: Hold onto rack with 1 arm, thumbs down position. Shift the hips away from the stretching arm.

exercises.label: 1b
exercises.name: Band Over And Back
exercises.notes: Take the band overhead with lateral tension, then straight down the spine rather than away from the back behind.

exercises.label: 1c
exercises.name: Banded T-spine Rotation
exercises.notes: Hook same band on rack, in tabletop position. Let band pull you under, then squeeze shoulder blade to get back to neutral. This movement will apply to the Main LFT in the workout.

exercises.label: 1d
exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: workout. Move band to face height. Pull with both hands, keeping band in the fingers.

exercises.label: 1e
exercises.name: Explosive Horizontal Band Press
exercises.notes: Use same band set up, keep tension on the band. Punch out on each rep. switch sides after :30

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.notes: Build to a heavy 3 to 5 rep max. Let your ability to maintain good positioning be the indicator for loading. Bench goes back to Alley at end

exercises.name: BB RNT RDL
exercises.notes: Use a light band to reinforce proper hinging mechanics. Be sure to pull bar into the body!

exercises.name: Single Arm Bench Deadstop Row
exercises.notes: Let the DB rest on the ground between reps, emphasize a big pull , allowing for some rotation thru the trunk.

exercises.name: DB Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: One leg at a time. Focus on driving thru the front foot and lowering with control.

exercises.name: Double Trouble: KB clean, KB squat, KB RDL, Hop x 3e from BSS
exercises.location: one in RACK, one on GAP
exercises.notes: 1 partner on roller, 1 partner on box. Or share the box

sections.time_note: Focus on finding today’s range of motion and activating the supporting muscle groups for the big LFT

exercises.label: 1a
exercises.name: Dynamic Pigeon
exercises.notes: Keep the back leg active and straight, focus on rotating the hips around the leg bone.

exercises.label: 1b
exercises.name: Bird Dog Contra-laterals
exercises.notes: Keep the core engaged and move slowly

exercises.label: 1c
exercises.name: Glute Bridge Pull Apart
exercises.notes: Bridge up, keep glutes tight, pull band apart. Let fists touch the floor. This bracing will apply to the Main LFT in the workout.

exercises.label: 1d
exercises.name: Prisoner Good Morning
exercises.notes: to the Main LFT in the workout. Butt goes back, squeeze to stand up.

exercises.label: 1e
exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Jump out as far as possible. Landing in deep squat position, owning each landing, walk back and reset before jumping again.

exercises.label: 2a
exercises.name: Banded Sumo Deadlift
exercises.notes: Attach bands over bar onto band pegs on base of rack. Wide stance, toed out. Make the movement move squatty than hinge-y. Work in the DROPZONE

exercises.label: 2b
exercises.name: DB Chest Supported Row
exercises.notes: the DROPZONE Set bench to 45 degree angle. Pull DBs to lower ribs and keep tension through the legs. Ladies can move their sensitive parts above the top of the bench at a lower angle.

exercises.label: 3a
exercises.name: 1DB Front Foot Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Front foot on 45lb plate, keep knees over toes;

exercises.label: 3b
exercises.name: DB SA Bench Press
exercises.notes: Lie flat on bench, engage core, punch DB to ceiling. Lower with control.

exercises.label: 4a
exercises.name: Landmine Heels
exercises.notes: Place end of bar in goblet position, heels on plate. Sit and drive knees over toes.

exercises.label: 4b
exercises.name: Elevated Goblet Squat Band Tall Kneeling X
exercises.notes: Place bands around pull up bar. Cross bands over, pull elbows to ribs, slowly return, repeat.

exercises.name: hanging knee raise
exercises.notes: Switch partners when too tired to continue/ or give specific reps 10s rest for singles

exercises.label: 1a
exercises.name: Hinged Over SA Lat Stretch
exercises.notes: On a rack upright, with hand slightly higher than shoulder. Shift hips away from hand.

exercises.label: 1b
exercises.name: Shoulder CAR 1/2 kneeling
exercises.notes: Slowly take arm into big circle. Focus on using muscles of shoulder to create movement. Let hand rotate.

exercises.label: 1c
exercises.name: Band Straight Arm Pulldown
exercises.notes: Pull bad to lap with straight arms in hinged position, keep tension on the band for the entire movement. This bracing will apply to the Main LFT in the workout.

exercises.label: 1d
exercises.name: Band SA Power Row
exercises.notes: Main LFT in the workout. With one arm, big drive of elbow behind.

exercises.label: 1e
exercises.name: Med Ball Slam
exercises.notes: Big Slams from overhead. Reset after each slam. Take 2 breaths between reps.

exercises.label: 2a
exercises.name: Kettlebell Upright Row
exercises.notes: Stand hip distant apart and zip kettlebell up front of body. Option is to use the bar.

exercises.label: 2b
exercises.instruction: Place Bench in ALLEY

exercises.label: 3a
exercises.name: DB Back Support Single Arm Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Adjust bench to upright position, press DB to ceiling. Keep core engaged and drive feet thru the floor to press weight.

exercises.label: 3b
exercises.name: Band X rear delt pull Apart
exercises.notes: Attach a band to each upright, cross bands. Complete rear delt fly. Keep core engaged. Take wider stance if needed for additional balance.

exercises.label: 4a
exercises.name: Body Row
exercises.notes: . Position chest under bar bodyweight, possibly loaded.

exercises.label: 4b
exercises.name: Band Triceps Press Down
exercises.notes: Move bands to side of pull up bar. Holding on to bands, lean forward slightly. Press bands towards floor. Keep tension on band at all times.

exercises.name: Plate Bent over Rear Delt Raise
exercises.notes: Go lighter than you think you need to. Use the 2.5/5lb plates. Reduce momentum. Rest 10s as needed.

sections.name: Training Prep
sections.time_note: Focus on finding today’s range of motion and activating the supporting muscle groups for the big LFT

exercises.label: 1a
exercises.name: Dynamic Pigeon
exercises.notes: Keep the back leg active and straight, focus on rotating the hips around the leg bone.

exercises.label: 1b
exercises.name: Bird Dog Contra-laterals
exercises.notes: Keep the core engaged and move slowly

exercises.label: 1c
exercises.name: Quadruped Rocking
exercises.notes: Shift weight back and forth. Keeping neutral spine and braced core. This bracing will apply to the Main LFT in the workout.

exercises.label: 1d
exercises.name: Prisoner Good Morning
exercises.notes: Butt goes back, squeeze to stand up.

exercises.label: 1e
exercises.name: Tuck Jump
exercises.notes: Jump up as up high as possible, bringing knees towards chest. Landing softly in squat position, owning each landing, reset before jumping again.

exercises.label: 2a
exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.notes: 90s rest between sets minimum, build to a heavy set of 2 for today. Keep elbows high in front rack position. Sit straight down, keeping torso tall through the entire movement.

exercises.label: 2b
exercises.name: Loaded Push Up
exercises.notes: movement. Set up for push up with hands outside shoulder width and middle fingers pointed straight ahead. Place plate on middle of back. Lower and press away with control. Elevate the hands as needed.

exercises.label: 3a
exercises.name: Barbell Zercher Split Squat
exercises.notes: Hold BB in crook of elbows. Set up in split squat position. Drop knee to ground, keeping a slight forward lean to engage the glutes.

exercises.label: 3b
exercises.name: DB Rotational Row in Lunge
exercises.notes: Set up in lunge position, pull DB from ground with slight rotation at the top and bottom. Lower body stays static, upper back is where rotation comes from.

exercises.label: 3c
exercises.instruction: Bench stored in the GAP against Wall

exercises.label: 4a
exercises.name: 1KB Kickstand Crossbody RDL
exercises.notes: Set up in 1.5/kickstand stance. Hold weight opposite of planted foot. Rotation through the trunk as you hinge and lower the weight towards your opposite pinky toe. Use glutes and upper back to rotate back to standing.

exercises.label: 4b
exercises.name: DB Fly Press
exercises.notes: and upper back to rotate back to standing. Lie on bench, lower and slightly bend elbows into field goal position at bottom of movement. Get a big stretch on pecs and press back up.

exercises.name: Plate Press out Squat
exercises.notes: Use a 5-10lb plate. Squat and press the plate away from your body. Stand up and pull the plate in. Take 10s breaks as needed.

exercises.notes: In table to position, slightly lift knees off ground, rock back and forth by pushing/pulling with arms to open up ankles and knees

exercises.notes: Table top position, make slow circles with the knee, trying to get bigger with each pass. . This bracing will apply to the Main LFT in the workout.

exercises.name: BW Squat
exercises.notes: Create tension, slowly pull into deep squat position , press out to stand up.

exercises.notes: 1 jump at a time, setting up each one and landing with control in deep squat.

exercises.name: Back Squat

exercises.label: 2b

exercises.notes: Band around shelf on rack and around bar. Hold BB with comfortable distance grip and hinge back into RDL. Band tension will force greater lat engagement.

exercises.notes: From hang position, pull shoulder blades down. Use lower body help by standing on box if hang is not possible. This bracing will apply to the Main LFT in the workout.

exercises.name: Band Face Pull

exercises.name: Ball Slam
exercises.notes: Use your lats to slam the ball down.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent Over Row

exercises.instruction: USE BENCH IN RACK

exercises.name: DB Single Arm Incline Press

exercises.label: 1a
exercises.name: Bulgarian Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: Rear foot elevated. Lower slowly intro stretch, squeeze glutes and quads to get a deeper stretch sensation.

exercises.label: 1b
exercises.name: 4pt Rocking
exercises.notes: In table to position, slightly lift knees off ground, rock back and forth by pushing/pulling with arms to open up ankles and knees

exercises.label: 1c
exercises.name: Quadruped Hip Circles
exercises.notes: Table top position, make slow circles with the knee, trying to get bigger with each pass. This bracing will apply to the Main LFT in the workout.

exercises.label: 1d
exercises.name: BW Squat
exercises.notes: Create tension, slowly pull into deep squat position , press out to stand up.

exercises.label: 1e
exercises.name: Squat Jump
exercises.notes: 1 jump at a time, setting up each one and landing with control in deep squat.

exercises.label: 2a
exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Build to a challenging 6. keep core engaged during lift.

exercises.label: 2b
exercises.instruction: Bench in GAP against WALL

exercises.label: 3a
exercises.name: RNT Barbell RDL
exercises.notes: Band around shelf on rack and around bar. Hold BB with comfortable distance grip and hinge back into RDL. Band tension will force greater lat engagement.

exercises.label: 3b
exercises.name: Lateral Step together Lunge
exercises.notes: Step into lateral lunge, stand up into stepping leg. Step into lunge on the other leg. Alternate sides

exercises.label: 3c
exercises.name: DB SL Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Shoulders on BOX, feet planted into ground. Big squeeze on glutes and press through foot to elevate the hips. Slow controlled descent. One side at a time.

exercises.label: 4a
exercises.name: Floating Heel Landmine Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Heels hovering off the floor, weight in balls of feet., holding LM at chest height. Slight lean forward into bar for stability.

exercises.label: 4b
exercises.name: Seated Leg HS Curl
exercises.notes: forward into bar for stability. Seated on bench, hook back around back of heel (attached to rack). Lean back while holding onto bench, pull heels to butt.

exercises.label: 4c
exercises.name: Deficit Calf Raise
exercises.notes: holding onto bench, pull heels to butt. Toes on plate, raise and lower to pump calves.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge to Curtsy Lunge
exercises.notes: Switch sides once you feel a burn+3reps

exercises.label: 1a
exercises.name: Hinged Over Single Arm Lat Stretch
exercises.notes: Hold onto rack with 1 arm, thumbs down position. Shift the hips away from the stretching arm.

exercises.label: 1b
exercises.name: Band Over And Back
exercises.notes: Take the band overhead with lateral tension, then straight down the spine rather than away from the back behind.

exercises.name: Hanging Scap Shrug
exercises.notes: From hang position, pull shoulder blades down. Use lower body help by standing on box if hang is not possible. This bracing will apply to the Main LFT in the workout.

exercises.label: 1d
exercises.name: Band Face Pull
exercises.notes: to the Main LFT in the workout. Move band to face height. Pull with both hands, keeping band in the fingers.

exercises.label: 1e
exercises.name: Ball Slam
exercises.notes: Use your lats to slam the ball down.

exercises.label: 2a
exercises.name: Barbell Bent Over Row
exercises.notes: Build to a challenging 6. keep core engaged during each rep. Slow tempo. Use catches to load and hold weight.

exercises.label: 2b
exercises.instruction: USE BENCH IN RACK

exercises.label: 3a
exercises.name: DB Single Arm Incline Press
exercises.notes: Bench set to 45degrees. Engage core, press feet through floor to drive weight to ceiling.

exercises.label: 3b
exercises.name: DB Single Arm Bicep Curl
exercises.notes: Hold DB in 1 arm. Curl to shoulder. Keep body still.

exercises.label: 3c
exercises.name: High Angle Single arm Band Row
exercises.notes: Set up a band on upright. Pull with one hand in ½ kneeling position. Loop band around wrist to avoid irritating elbow/grip. Drive elbow back with force on each rep.

exercises.label: 4a
exercises.name: DB Deadstop Row with Hand Support
exercises.notes: Use bench for support, pull the DB from the ground on each rep.

exercises.label: 4b
exercises.name: Box Dip
exercises.notes: Hands on box, knees bent or straight. Manage depth so shoulders don’t get grumpy. Load with Plate as needed.

exercises.label: 4c
exercises.name: Bent Over Plate Raise
exercises.notes: Holding plates, hinge over, raise plates level with shoulders/upper back. .

exercises.name: Dead Bug Leg Raise with Upper body Ball Squeeze
exercises.notes: Lying on back, squeeze ball with straight arms. Slowly raise and lower one leg at a time.

exercises.label: 1a
exercises.name: 1/2 kneeling hip flexor
exercises.notes: Gently rock into and out of stretch to open the front of the hips.

exercises.label: 1b
exercises.name: Contralateral Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Engage the core and slowly lower opposite arm & leg to the ground, keeping core engaged during return to starting position , repeat with other limbs.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilts

sections.name: Training Prep
sections.time_note: Focus on finding today’s range of motion and activating the supporting muscle groups for the big LFT

exercises.label: 1a
exercises.name: Hinged Over Single Arm Lat Stretch
exercises.notes: Hold onto rack with 1 arm, thumbs down position. Shift the hips away from the stretching arm.

exercises.label: 1b
exercises.name: Band Over And Back
exercises.notes: Take the band overhead with lateral tension, then straight down the spine rather than away from the back behind.

exercises.label: 1c
exercises.name: Banded T-spine Rotation
exercises.notes: Hook same band on rack, in tabletop position. Let band pull you under, then squeeze shoulder blade to get back to neutral. This movement will apply to the Main LFT in the workout.

exercises.label: 1d
exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Move band to face height. Pull with both hands, keeping band in the fingers.

exercises.label: 1e
exercises.name: Explosive Band Horizontal Press
exercises.notes: Use same band set up, keep tension on the band. Punch out on each rep. switch sides after :30

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.notes: Build to a heavy 3 to 5 rep max. Let your ability to maintain good positioning be the indicator for loading. Bench goes back to Alley at end

exercises.name: BB RNT RDL
exercises.notes: Use a light band to reinforce proper hinging mechanics. Be sure to pull bar into the body!

exercises.label: 4a
exercises.name: Single Arm Bench Deadstop Row
exercises.notes: Let the DB rest on the ground between reps, emphasize a big pull , allowing for some rotation thru the trunk.

exercises.label: 4b
exercises.name: Single Arm Arnold Press
exercises.notes: rotation thru the trunk. Start with DB infront of you with palm facing you. Rotate as you press OH.

exercises.name: DB Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: One leg at a time. Focus on driving thru the front foot and lowering with control.

exercises.label: 4b
exercises.name: Hamstring Body Curls
exercises.notes: Set up barbell to belly level. Pull box over. Hold body row position and curl body by pulling through heels on box to challenge hamstrings.

exercises.label: F1
exercises.name: Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Partner A does exercise 1 for 50 seconds

exercises.label: F2
exercises.name: Loaded Push Up
exercises.notes: then switches with partner B and then repeats for second half
